title: Kinda Vanilla !!
description: Enhances your Vanilla Experience in a better way. Compatible with most Vanilla Servers.
body:
# Kinda Vanilla!!! 🍦 ![Kinda Vanilla Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aee8838f654a123dbd96f50ae698b0e4a58a5599.png) **The Minecraft you Know, Just... Better** --- ## ✨ Overview **Kinda Vanilla!!!** is a carefully curated Vanilla+ modpack designed to polish the diamond that is Minecraft. We believe the base game is incredible, but it deserves a little extra flavor. The base game is fantastic, in our opinion, but it needs a little more flavour. With improved performance, quality-of-life adjustments, and lively graphics, this pack aims to preserve the essence of the game while making every click feel more satisfying. ### Blazing Performance Say goodbye to stuttering and low frame rates. Optimized from the ground up, this pack ensures a smooth experience even on modest hardware using modern performance mods like [sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), [lithum](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium), [ferritecore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core), and others. Whether you're running shaders or building massive farms, the performance remains rock solid. ### Quality of Life (QoL) Features you’ll wonder how you ever lived without. * **Smarter Inventories:** Better sorting and management. * **Subtle UI Tweaks:** lively animations that respect the classic Minecraft aesthetic and make the game alive. * **World Interaction:** Better in-game animations, visual workstations, minimap and worldmap support, and more stuff to explore. ### Lively Graphics Using a curated combination of resource packs and mods, the world looks sharper and more alive. Experience enhanced lighting and color clarity without losing that iconic blocky charm. --- ## 🛠️ Installation **Download a Launcher:** We recommend using [Prism Launcher](https://prismlauncher.org/), [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/app), or [CurseForge](https://download.curseforge.com/). - *Search for "Kinda Vanilla!!!":* Find the pack in the browser. - *Click Install:* The launcher will handle all dependencies and versions. - *Allocate RAM:* We recommend allocating at least **4GB of RAM** for the best experience. --- ## 🔗 Links & Socials * **Discord:** [Join our community!](https://discord.gg/s8NrjdH4bR) * **Report Issues:** [GitHub Issue Tracker]([https://github.com/yourlink/issues](https://github.com/symmetrixXD/Kinda-Vanilla-/issues)) ---

Developed with ❤️ for the Minecraft community.
